title: DAY 4 — LESSON 5: ADMITTING MISTAKES AND APOLOGISING SINCERELY

questions.prompt: What does admitting a mistake mean?
options: Honestly acknowledging an error and the responsibility that genuinely belongs to you
Avoiding discussion until the problem disappears

questions.prompt: Which statement is the most sincere apology?
options: I'm sorry I entered the wrong appointment time. I'll correct it and verify bookings more carefully.

questions.prompt: What should an employee do after discovering an error that may affect client safety?
options: Wait to see whether anyone notices
Take necessary immediate safety action and promptly report the issue

questions.prompt: Why is an apology alone sometimes insufficient?
options: Because the mistake may also require correction, reporting or follow-through

questions.prompt: What should you do if someone wrongly blames you for a mistake?
options: Clarify the facts respectfully without falsely admitting responsibility
Accept the blame even when you know it is untrue
Insult the person making the accusation
